message.content: Local deployment can reduce some privacy risks by minimizing the data that is revealed in queries sent to a machine learning model. This is achieved through privacy-preserving techniques that allow one party to retrieve a prediction or classification without revealing all of the information to the party running the model. These techniques enable one party to get an answer without having to fully reveal the question. Additionally, local deployment can be used to minimize data protection responsibilities by allowing the model to be applied to other individuals that were not part of the training dataset on the basis of its predictive features. This approach ensures that the data protection law applies at multiple stages of the processing, including the development stage, where processing of individuals' personal data to train the model, and the deployment stage, where the results of the model are applied to other individuals.
